name: திருவிவிலியம் (Tiruviviliam, common-language Tamil Bible with the deuterocanonical books)
publisher: Tamil Nadu Biblical Catechetical and Liturgical Centre (TNBCLC) and the Bible Society of India
numbering: Hebrew psalm numbering; psalm superscriptions are not numbered (they are part of the heading on the site and are not included), so Ps 51:1 = 'கடவுளே! உமது பேரன்புகேற்ப'. Joel has 3 chapters and Malachi 4 (English-style division). Esther = the Hebrew text (10 ch.); the Greek Esther is a separate book, stored as esther-greek (10 ch., the whole Greek text with lettered verses 1:1a-1s, 3:13a-g, 4:17a-z, 5:1a-2b, 8:12a-x, 10:3a-l; the unnumbered opening of Greek Est 5:1 is stored as key '1'). Daniel = the Hebrew/Aramaic text (12 ch., Dan 3 ends at v.30); the additions are a separate book, stored as daniel-greek: ch.1 = Prayer of Azariah and Song of the Three Young Men (vv.1-67 = Dan 3:24-90), ch.2 = Susanna, ch.3 = Bel and the Dragon. No Sirach prologue on the site. Where the edition combines verses, the key is the combined range as given (e.g. Mark 1 '2-3', Luke 1 '50-53', Rom 1 '1,7'); split verses keep the edition's own letters (e.g. Mark 6 '6a','6b', Tobit 4 '7a','7b'). Where the site repeats the same verse number for two parts of one verse (Gen 2:4, Song 8:5, Ezek 1:28, Mic 5:5, John 8:41, 16:4, 18:38, Acts 9:19) the parts are joined under that number. Footnote asterisks removed; poetry line breaks flattened to spaces; two stray brace typos of the site removed (Eccl 12:12, Jer 1:10). Brackets around doubtful verses (e.g. Luke 22:43-44) kept as printed.
